notes.title: Polish version released.
notes.notes:
You can now play the base game plus 7 expansions in polish language.

Have fun!

notes.title: version 7.0 again
notes.notes:
Yuo can again play the expansions in any order that you like.

We changed this since it seems this is a better option overall.

notes.title: version 7.1
notes.notes:
In this version you do the expansions in order.

You can do expansion 1 once you enter the expansion house.
However to do expansion 2 you need to unluck it by completeing all quest in expansion 1 first.
This goes for all expansons.
